ticks_per_frame.description: Engine ticks (60 Hz) per frame of the original's story; the original's is 3.

variable_max.description: The highest value of a story variable; a write past either end stops there.

frozen_variable.description: The variable that holds frozen_value while a script holds the player still.

frozen_value.description: The value of frozen_variable while a script holds the player still.

talk_facing_trigger.description: The trigger every freeze clears, which keeps a talk's two sides from turning to each other.

show_name_variable.description: The variable that says whether a script's map change shows the new map's name.

show_name_by_event.description: show_name_variable's value for: no name when the section is an event.

show_name_always.description: show_name_variable's value for: always show the name.

show_name_never.description: show_name_variable's value for: never show the name.

capacity.description: What the ruleset adds to the original's 800 triggers and 256 variables, for mods (docs/modding/historia.md). Left out, nothing.

extra_triggers.description: Triggers after the base's 800, numbered from 800.

extra_variables.description: Variables after the base's 256, numbered from 256; every one is saved.

extra_variable_max.description: The highest value of an extra variable; a write past either end stops there.

extra_raised.description: Raised triggers for the species from 63 on: species 63 + k is trigger first_trigger + k, for k below species. They must lie in the extra triggers.
